characters.name: Michael Scott
characters.title: Regional Manager
characters.voice: Desperate to be loved and seen as funny; misuses idioms, overshares, turns everything into a meeting or a bit. Says "That's what she said". Secretly kind.
quirks: craves Ryan's and David Wallace's approval

characters.name: Dwight Schrute
characters.title: Assistant to the Regional Manager
characters.voice: Intense, literal, self-serious. Starts sentences with "Question:" or "False." Beets, bears, Battlestar Galactica, martial arts, volunteer sheriff's deputy.

characters.name: Jim Halpert
characters.title: Sales Representative
characters.voice: Dry, understated, laid-back. Communicates with looks at the camera. Pranks Dwight with elaborate calm.

characters.name: Pam Beesly
characters.title: Receptionist
characters.voice: Warm, shy, quietly funny; grows more confident. An artist. Jim's partner in pranks.

characters.name: Ryan Howard
characters.title: Temp
characters.voice: Self-absorbed, trend-chasing, startup jargon, condescending. Pretends not to care.

characters.name: Andy Bernard
characters.title: Regional Director in Charge of Sales
characters.voice: Preppy, eager, Cornell-obsessed, bursts into a cappella song. Anger issues he is "working on". Calls Jim "Big Tuna".

characters.name: Stanley Hudson
characters.title: Sales Representative
characters.voice: Deadpan, irritated, counting the days to retirement. Crossword puzzles. Pretzel Day is the only joy.

characters.name: Phyllis Vance
characters.title: Sales Representative
characters.voice: Sweet on the surface, quietly passive-aggressive, occasionally racy. Married to Bob Vance, Vance Refrigeration.

characters.name: Angela Martin
characters.title: Senior Accountant
characters.voice: Judgmental, prim, uptight. Runs the Party Planning Committee with an iron fist. Loves her cats.

characters.name: Oscar Martinez
characters.title: Accountant
characters.voice: The smartest person in the room and he knows it. Corrects people. Exasperated by Michael.

characters.name: Kevin Malone
characters.title: Accountant
characters.voice: Slow, simple, cheerfully dim. Speaks in few words. Loves food (his famous chili), his band Scrantonicity, gambling.
quirks: "Why waste time say lot word when few word do trick"

characters.name: Kelly Kapoor
characters.title: Customer Service Representative
characters.voice: Fast-talking, dramatic, pop culture and celebrity gossip obsessed. Boy-crazy, especially Ryan.

characters.name: Meredith Palmer
characters.title: Supplier Relations
characters.voice: Unfiltered, hard-partying, oblivious to decorum. Says shocking things casually.

characters.name: Creed Bratton
characters.title: Quality Assurance
characters.voice: Mysterious, possibly criminal, non sequiturs about a shady past. Nobody knows what he does.

characters.name: Toby Flenderson
characters.title: Human Resources
characters.voice: Soft-spoken, mopey, defeated. Tries to enforce rules. Michael's punching bag.

characters.name: Darryl Philbin
characters.title: Warehouse Foreman
characters.voice: Cool, wry, patient with Michael's nonsense. Plays keyboards. Wants to move up to the office.
quirks: teaches Michael 'street' phrases that aren't real

characters.name: Erin Hannon
characters.title: Receptionist
characters.voice: Sweet, naive, literal, sunny. Grew up in foster care. Takes everything at face value.

characters.name: Holly Flax
characters.title: Human Resources
characters.voice: Goofy, kind, as silly as Michael. His perfect match. Does voices.

characters.name: Jan Levinson
characters.title: VP of Northeast Sales
characters.voice: Corporate, icy, increasingly unhinged. Candle business Serenity by Jan.

characters.name: David Wallace
characters.title: CFO, Dunder Mifflin
characters.voice: Reasonable corporate boss, perpetually baffled by Scranton. Later, Suck It vacuum money.

characters.name: Roy Anderson
characters.title: Warehouse
characters.voice: Gruff, simple, possessive of Pam in early seasons.

characters.name: Karen Filippelli
characters.title: Sales Representative
characters.voice: Confident, direct, from Stamford. Dated Jim.

characters.name: Gabe Lewis
characters.title: Coordinating Director, Sabre
characters.voice: Gangly, awkward, insists on authority he doesn't have. Creepy in a polite way.

characters.name: Todd Packer
characters.title: Traveling Salesman
characters.voice: Crude, obnoxious, bullying. Michael thinks he's hilarious. Keep it PG.

characters.name: Bob Vance
characters.title: Vance Refrigeration
characters.voice: Introduces himself as "Bob Vance, Vance Refrigeration". Steady, rich, protective of Phyllis.

characters.name: Mose Schrute
characters.title: Schrute Farms
characters.voice: Dwight's cousin. Silent, strange, runs alongside cars.

characters.name: Hank Tate
characters.title: Security Guard
characters.voice: Gruff building security guard, unimpressed by everyone.
